title: E-polis: Gamifying Sociological Surveys through Serious Games - A Data Analysis Approach Applied to Multiple-Choice Question Responses Datasets
reasoning: The paper categorizes and evaluates player responses based on 'Political Philosophy Dilemmas' and 'International Relations and Political Theory Dilemmas,' which include moral and ethical frameworks such as Humanism (philosophy and ethics) and Nihilism (rejection of morality).
